notificationAccounting.observer: in-memory signed-queue submission collector, not a queue consumer or provider
notificationAccounting.browserFirst: First capture makes1 queue attempt; lost hosted acknowledgement recovery makes another under existing policy; completed same-key replay adds0. Guest accepts2 attempts with one logical key. Bound first attempt fails, then accepts1 retry.
notificationAccounting.webhookFirst: Two existing internal confirmations make2 attempts with one logical key; the browser, its same-key recovery and completed replay add0. Bound first fails then the existing internal retry accepts1.
notificationAccounting.concurrent: Canonical capture winner determines sender ownership. Browser-owned capture yields2 competing initial attempts and a browser-owned recovery attempt; webhook-owned capture yields1 initial attempt and0 browser additions. If its first submission fails, the same original internal transition retries. Stable logical key remains1; external delivery exactly-once is NOT_PROVEN.
notificationAccounting.paidEventCommittedButQueueFailed: Explicit in bound paths; durable order.paid may exist while first submission failed. Retry stays allowed; accepted queue submission is distinct from delivery.
notificationAccounting.directResendAndConsumerDeduplication: NOT_PROVEN; requires the exact separate helper/consumer scope request, never inferred from one event/enqueue.
